description: ManageCategoriesActivity.kt defines an Android activity that allows users to add and remove categories, interfacing with a NoteRepository to manage category data and updating the UI accordingly.

classes.name: ManageCategoriesActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for managing categories, supporting add and delete operations with a ListView and repository interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and defines click listeners for adding and removing categories.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the ListView to display the current categories from the repository.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar item clicks; specifically, navigates back when the home button is pressed.
